prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/shelf-moss.png in this repo. Use a square size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.

Image prompt:
Photograph, straight-on eye-level product shot. A pale warm-grey lime plaster wall fills the background, smooth and matte. The bottom fifth of the frame is the front edge of a dark weathered pine shelf board. On the shelf, centred slightly left and about 45% of the frame width, sits a square slab of living green cushion moss lifted on a thin cedar board, its dark soil edge visible at the sides, with one small flat grey stepping stone set into the moss. Plenty of empty wall around the object. Soft diffused daylight from the left, gentle shadow to the right. Muted, natural colours, realistic, high detail, 50mm lens. No text, no people, no other objects, no HDR. Square 1:1.
